title: Unit – 1 : Session – 8 : SLO – 2  |  Types of Computing Environments — Unscramble
sections: TRADITIONAL — standalone PCs/workstations on a LAN with client-server services.
CLIENT-SERVER — clients request services; centralized servers respond.
PEER-TO-PEER (P2P) — every node acts as both client and server; no central server.
CLOUD COMPUTING — on-demand compute/storage over the internet (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS).
MOBILE — smartphones/tablets with resource-constrained, touch-centric OSes (Android, iOS).
EMBEDDED — OS inside dedicated devices (cars, appliances, IoT); often real-time.
DISTRIBUTED — many networked computers cooperating to appear as one system.
REAL-TIME — strict timing deadlines; used in control systems.
